extraFacts.fact: MSS SP-67 is the standards body specification for butterfly valves; EN 12266-1 and ISO 5208 define valve leakage test rates, with rate A the tightest.
extraFacts.source: MSS SP-67 (Butterfly Valves); ISO 5208 / EN 12266-1 (Industrial valves - pressure testing of valves); both cited on the Victaulic 761 listing

faqs.q: What is the Victaulic Series 700 grooved butterfly valve 3 inch used for?
faqs.a: The Victaulic Series 700 is a grooved-end butterfly valve for carbon steel, ductile iron and plastic piping, rated 200 psi (14 bar) maximum working pressure. The 3″ size joins 3.500″ (88.9 mm) OD pipe with Victaulic grooved couplings, so no flanges or flange bolts are needed.

faqs.q: Which pipe does the Victaulic Series 700 3 inch valve fit?
faqs.a: It fits grooved pipe of 3.500″ (88.9 mm) outside diameter, joined with Victaulic grooved couplings. It is for carbon steel, ductile iron and plastic piping; with other pipe materials the system designer should confirm compatibility.

faqs.q: What is the maximum working pressure of the Victaulic Series 700 3 inch valve?
faqs.a: The Series 700 is rated 200 psi (1400 kPa / 14 bar) maximum working pressure in the 3″ size. The listing gives no vacuum rating for it, so confirm vacuum duty with us before you order.

faqs.q: What seats and temperature limits does the Victaulic Series 700 have?
faqs.a: EPDM (green colour code) runs from −30°F to +230°F (−34°C to +110°C) and is not for petroleum or steam. Nitrile (orange) runs from −20°F to +180°F (−29°C to +82°C) and is not for hot water above +150°F, hot dry air above +140°F or steam.

faqs.q: What is the Victaulic Series 700 3 inch valve made of?
faqs.a: The housing is ductile iron to ASTM A536 Grade 65-45-12 and the body is elastomer-lined carbon steel with a black alkyd enamel. The disc is aluminium bronze (C95300 or C64200) as standard with CF8M stainless steel optional, and the stems are 416 stainless steel.

faqs.q: What are the Cv and weight of the Victaulic Series 700 3 inch valve?
faqs.a: The flow coefficient Cv is 180 (Kv 156) fully open and the approximate weight is 6.8 lb (3.1 kg). Use the Cv to check pressure drop.

faqs.q: What operators are available for the Victaulic Series 700 3 inch valve?
faqs.a: It is supplied with the standard cast ductile iron lever handle or with a lockable handle. Say which you need when you enquire.

faqs.q: How do I choose the seat grade on the Victaulic Series 700 valve?
faqs.a: Match the colour code to the service: green EPDM for water, orange nitrile for oil service. The seat grade on each unit is confirmed when we quote, so check the colour code on the valve against your service.

faqs.q: Victaulic Series 700 or Vic-300 MasterSeal 761: which should I choose?
faqs.a: The Series 700 is a 200 psi grooved valve with a lever handle in the 3″ size, while the [Vic-300 MasterSeal 761 in 4″](/p/victaulic-vic-300-masterseal-series-761-butterfly-valve-4-inch-300-psi) is rated from full vacuum to 300 psi with dead-end service and an actuator flange. Choose the 761 for higher pressure, vacuum or automation.

faqs.q: Where are the Victaulic Series 700 figures from?
faqs.a: The figures on the listing are from Victaulic publication 08.05 (Rev K). The listing gives no other standards for the 3″ Series 700, so we claim none; see [wafer, lug and grooved butterfly valves](/blog/butterfly-valves-wafer-lug-and-grooved) for how grooved valves compare.

faqs.q: Where is the Victaulic Series 700 3 inch valve made and what lead time applies?
faqs.a: The listing gives no country of origin for this Victaulic valve. Typically dispatched within 14 working days. We export from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond; give the destination for the invoice and origin papers.

faqs.q: What is the lead time for the Victaulic Series 700 3 inch butterfly valve?
faqs.a: Typically dispatched within 14 working days. Send the handle type (standard or lockable), the seat and the quantity through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the price and the delivery for the 3″ Series 700.

faqs.q: What is the Victaulic Vic-300 MasterSeal Series 761 butterfly valve used for?
faqs.a: The Victaulic Vic-300 MasterSeal Series 761 is a grooved-end butterfly valve rated from full vacuum to 300 psi (21 bar), with full working pressure for bi-directional dead-end service. The 4″ size fits 4.500″ (114.3 mm) OD pipe and has an ISO 5211 mounting flange for direct actuator mounting.

faqs.q: Which pipe does the Victaulic Series 761 4 inch valve fit?
faqs.a: Grooved pipe of 4.500″ (114.3 mm) outside diameter, connected with Victaulic grooved couplings. The end-to-end length is 4.63″ (117.6 mm), and the Cv is 820 (Kv 707) fully open.

faqs.q: What pressure and vacuum does the Victaulic Series 761 4 inch valve handle?
faqs.a: From full vacuum (29.9 in Hg) up to 300 psi (2100 kPa / 21 bar), at full working pressure for dead-end service. A one-time system test at 1½ times working pressure is permitted before start-up, at ambient conditions.

faqs.q: What seats and temperature limits does the Victaulic Series 761 have?
faqs.a: EPDM (green) runs from −30°F to +230°F and is not for petroleum or steam. Nitrile (orange) runs from +10°F to +150°F, and fluoroelastomer (blue) from +20°F to +300°F, which is not for steam.

faqs.q: What is the Victaulic Series 761 4 inch valve made of?
faqs.a: The body and end face are ductile iron to ASTM A536 Grade 65-45-12, black coated. The disc is electroless-nickel-coated ductile iron as standard, with CF8M stainless steel or C95500 aluminium bronze optional at 4″, and the stem is 416 stainless steel with 17-4PH optional.

faqs.q: Which standards does the Victaulic Series 761 meet?
faqs.a: The listing states construction and performance meet or exceed MSS SP-67, with closure/seat leakage rate A to EN 12266-1, EN 1074-1, EN 1074-2 and ISO 5208. It is not recommended for potable water in stainless steel or copper systems.

faqs.q: How do I automate the Victaulic Series 761 4 inch valve?
faqs.a: It has an ISO 5211 F07 actuator mounting flange, so a quarter-turn actuator bolts directly on. At 4″ it is offered bare, with a 10-position handle (infinitely variable, padlockable, with memory stop) or with a gear operator.

faqs.q: Can the Victaulic Series 761 be used at the end of a line?
faqs.a: Yes. The listing marks it end-of-line capable, with full working pressure for bi-directional dead-end service up to 300 psi.

faqs.q: Victaulic Series 761 or Series 700 grooved butterfly valve: what is the difference?
faqs.a: The 761 is rated from full vacuum to 300 psi with dead-end service and an ISO 5211 flange, while the [Series 700 in 3″](/p/victaulic-series-700-grooved-butterfly-valve-3-inch-200-psi) is rated 200 psi with a lever or lockable handle. Choose the 761 for pressure, vacuum or actuators.

faqs.q: How heavy is the Victaulic Series 761 4 inch valve?
faqs.a: The Series 761 weighs about 9.3 lb (4.2 kg) as a bare 4″ valve. Add the weight of the operator or actuator when you plan the support.

faqs.q: Where is the Victaulic Series 761 made and what lead time applies?
faqs.a: The listing gives no country of origin for this Victaulic valve. Typically dispatched within 14 working days. We export from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond; give the destination for the invoice and origin papers.

faqs.q: What is the lead time for the Victaulic Vic-300 MasterSeal 761 butterfly valve?
faqs.a: Typically dispatched within 14 working days. Send the seat grade, the operator and the quantity through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the price and the delivery for the 4″ Series 761.
